objective: Implement authoritative invoices and the Accounts Receivable subledger defined by ACC.AR.CONTRACT.1 without taking ownership from source domains or Accounting.

repository.name: ACP-Enterprise
repository.start_rule: fetch origin and create an isolated worktree from the current origin/customer-management-v1

prohibited_paths: backend/app/accounting/** except consumption of an accepted public contract
persistence_owner: Invoicing owns invoice aggregates, issued revisions and lines, AR subledger entries, credits, write-offs, payment applications, and Accounting posting receipts; Accounting owns journals, periods, mappings, control accounts, and statements.

migration.parent_rule: descend from the single authoritative head after ACC.CORE.1
migration.reparent_rule: mechanical re-parenting is allowed only before application and only when schema semantics do not conflict

required_invariants: one AR obligation per issued invoice revision
issued evidence is immutable and corrections are compensating
open amount is derived from authoritative subledger evidence
AR aging reconciles to the AR subledger and Accounting control
invoice tax equals line tax and tax-liability posting input
idempotency replay returns the original result and contradictory replay fails
Company and Branch scope is enforced in storage, service, API, events, and UI
accounting posted state requires an Accounting posting receipt
missing financial evidence is never treated as zero
validation: deterministic totals, discount allocation, tax, rounding, and digest tests
credit memo, void, correction, write-off, and reversal tests
AR subledger replay, aging-input, and control-reconciliation tests
payment application, unapplication, overpayment, and duplicate tests with a fake accepted receipt contract
optimistic concurrency and transaction rollback tests
Company, Branch, customer/location, Estimate, and Job isolation tests
Business Event and Accounting posting-receipt contract tests
API and responsive frontend workflow tests
affected Customer, Estimate, Job, Price Book, tax-policy, Communications, and Platform regressions
Ruff, MyPy, ESLint, TypeScript typecheck, production frontend build, git diff --check, and focused secret scan
fresh Alembic upgrade, downgrade/re-upgrade, drift detection, and exactly one head

environment_gates.preview: separate owner authorization after integration and Finance review
environment_gates.production: separate owner authorization after ACC.IC.1, rehearsal, reconciliation, and go/no-go gates

completion: Finance inputs are configured and evidenced or fail-closed gates remain explicit
one exact-boundary commit is normally pushed
local and remote are synchronized with a clean tree and empty index
